_comment: A floor rather than a band: warm says 'at least this' and yields to anything already hotter, so it
sharpens a temperate Age and costs a scorching one nothing.
Everything past the temperature is only offered, since warm is the mildest thing a writer can say about
heat and should leave the rest of the world to whoever says more: a golden light, a yellower sun, a
little haze, and a lean towards what grows.
